name: SegmentedControl
summary: A radio group drawn as one pill of options, for a few mutually exclusive choices.
rungReason: Native radios in a fieldset keep the group's name, arrow-key selection and form value; each radio covers its label invisibly.

a11y.role: radio (implicit), in a group named by its legend
a11y.name: Each option's text; the legend for the group

keyboard.action: Enters the group at the checked option, and leaves it
Check the next or previous option (native; ArrowDown and ArrowUp too)
Check the focused option when none is checked

a11y.targetSize: Each option is at least --lue-size-target-min tall

rules: Two to five short options; more, or long labels, belong in a Radio group or Select
It chooses a value: to switch panels of content, use Tabs
withoutJavaScript: Works fully, and submits with its form
contrast: A strong ring round the checked option
forcedColors: SelectedItem for the checked option; the group has a CanvasText edge
